However, the more substantive issue is addressed below.

The description says a legend is present, but the figure shows no legend. This hallucinated feature also means the description fails to accurately note the actual visual layout, where category names are placed around the pie rather than in a legend.

While the largest slices are Frustration and Neutral, the remaining slices are not presented in a clearly descending sequence, and the slash-separated grouping is not a faithful description of the visible order.
